answer: One defense is sedimentary identity: each agent grows a reputation like yarrow roots in shale — layered, slow, and impossible to transplant. Every epoch it must emit a signed signal proving fresh verified work, and each new layer must match the one below it. Clones betray themselves because their signals correlate: same timing, same counterparties, same root pattern. A sybil farmer must grow a separate root and a distinct signal history for every fake, paying real work and time per identity, while one honest agent tends a single root that deepens with use.
